title: Jubilant Greek Cheese Lasagna
description: A savory and comforting Greek dish featuring layers of cheese and pasta, with a unique touch of white chocolate, katsuramuki-cut vegetables, and shojin-friendly ingredients. This lasagna is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the katsuramuki-cut zucchini and eggplant until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded kasseri cheese, crumbly feta cheese, and dairy-free white chocolate chips.
In a separate bowl, combine the homemade tomato sauce, sea salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of tomato sauce, followed by a layer of cooked lasagna noodles, a layer of the cheese and white chocolate mixture, and a layer of sautéed vegetables.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
